title: Gift Gift Of Land To School For Use As A Play Ground With Condition For Revocation On Breach Of Covenant By Donee
description: A gift gift of land to school for use as a play ground with condition for revocation on breach of covenant by donee used for testamentary documents (wills) or gift deeds for transfer of property. Suitable for testators making wills, donors gifting property, or their legal advisors. Key details required: Date (First Party), Date (Second Party), Name (First Party), Name (Second Party), Age (in years).
description_hi: Gift Gift Of Land To School For Use As A Play Ground With Condition For Revocation On Breach Of Covenant By Donee — वसीयतनामा (वसीयत) या संपत्ति हस्तांतरण के लिए उपहार विलेख के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला कानूनी प्रारूप। वसीयत बनाने वाले वसीयतकर्ता, संपत्ति उपहार देने वाले दाता, या उनके कानूनी सलाहकार के लिए उपयुक्त। 8 आवश्यक और 2 वैकल्पिक विवरण भरने होंगे।
